source_exclusions: All challenge data, wording, rubrics, images, transcripts, and failure records.
All bench/results files and raw F1a records.
All prior fixture domains and entity names; old development files read for schema only.
Production memories, private people, and real perception sources.
limits: Invented stored captions and literal utterances test retrieval only. No image, ASR, physical perception, identity, or answer correctness claim is established.
gold_usage: Evaluation only. Labels and decisive spans must never route retrieval or select indexed units.
label_semantics: Relevance includes related partial and superseded sources. Sufficiency means the source-kind pair supports the current requested fact. Similar alternates are relevant but insufficient. Every nonempty source-kind pair is labeled.
span_semantics: Zero-based half-open Python character offsets into caption or said. Spans include full decisive sentences.
commands: No embeddings, inference, threshold tuning, or comparison scoring were run.

selection_protocol.score: raw cosine native MaxSim per source-kind
selection_protocol.merge: Both kinds in descending raw cosine; exact ties favor observation, then source ID.
selection_protocol.delivery: Best-scoring indexed unit per selected source-kind, exact offsets and source hash.
selection_protocol.calibration: Highest grid floor -1.00 to 1.00 by 0.01 retaining at least 95% of relevant pairs per kind. Sufficiency and comparison never tune floors.
selection_protocol.pre_generation: No generation until retrieval improves; rendered 2048 context reserves 64 output and 256 image tokens.

scope_semantics: Scope is derived per source kind from literal text using existing Memory visitor rules; source points do not declare a shared override.
